open: Event name source is the Json member key (0x28d20c ldr r0,[r4,#0x1c]), not a "name" key: B1's key set (events/int/float/string, census §2.1) has no "name". Whether the game's skeleton JSON encodes events as an object keyed by name or as an array of unnamed objects is NOT confirmed — no skeleton JSON asset exists in this tree; the translation follows the instruction literally.

Json +0x0c semantics for non-array nodes: B1/B2 use it as the allocation count while the event loop ignores it. A declared-count/child-count mismatch is only observable under the fixture's oversized reserve(); this is a control-flow observation, not a malloc-capacity or parser claim.

B2 leaves animationsCount (+0x34) untouched; correctness relies on the parent's spSkeletonData_create calloc(1,84,tag,37) at 0x28ade4. Calling B2 on a non-zeroed record leaves a stale count — faithful to the binary, not repaired.
No error path exists in B1/B2 (no setError/dispose between 0x28d19c and 0x28d2d0); spEventData_create return is never checked, matching 0x28d210.
Parent loader assembly (B3 key caching, B4 timeline count + spAnimation_create, per-animation loop tail 0x28e774..0x28e79c) is out of scope.
The float field is stored as raw bits by 0x28d244 str r0,[r5,#0x8] (softfp ABI); this module preserves a float field at +0x08 and asserts bit equality, not FPSCR/NaN behavior.
